title: Blog
text:
The orientation was great. I felt excited to meet new people with different backgrounds and amazing instructors as well.
The first week of MDS was stressful because we had many new courses, and because my background was a non-CS background so I had to load tons of new stuff into my brain.
The workload actually suprised me. I am aware that the MDS is a accelerated program, but I still need more effort to keep up the pace.














My first weeks in MDS

title: Weizhuo Zhang
text:
I’m Weizhuo Zhang and I’m from China. I lived in Canada for almost 7 years. I’ve graduated from U of A and got my Astrophysics Bachelor’s degree, and then spent 1 year in London, UK pursing my MSc Astrophysics degree. I’ve worked as a product analyst for mobile games which applied simple data analysis to help the teams to make the right decision. I also did some web events UI/mechanism design for our game. I hope that I can learn more about programming with Python & R, ML skills, and higher level data manipulating skills from the MDS program.

title: About
section: I did the undergrad research in astrophysics and needed some data analytics skills, and this was the origin for my interest growing in data science. However, learning all the new stuff which involved heavy coding was diffcult for me, so I decided to improve my skills by attending data science. Furthermore, I would like to stay refreshed in the AI era.
